name: CLIProxyAPI
description: Run a managed local gateway for Gemini CLI, Codex, Claude, Antigravity, Kimi and xAI accounts, then use its discovered models in Vetta.
setup.title: Local model gateway
setup.subtitle: Connect subscription accounts and sync the models discovered by CLIProxyAPI into Vetta.
setup.oauthDescription: Choose a provider to authorize. The local gateway handles browser and device-code flows.
setup.oauthWaiting: Finish authorization in the provider page. This plugin is polling the local CLIProxyAPI service.
setup.oauthSuccess: Authorization completed. Accounts and models are being refreshed.
setup.replaceHint: Reauthorizing adds or updates an account. To switch accounts, remove the old one first.
setup.removeLocalOnly: This page only manages credentials stored locally by CLIProxyAPI. Revoke access from the provider's security settings if needed.
